description: Editing and reviewing a summary draft.

preconditions: A Ready draft exists; actor is the current chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting with a Ready draft; actorId: its current chair; edit: three corrected sections.
cases.return: Success with the fresh state (MSG388 "Đã lưu dự thảo."); the corrected text is stored and the review is cleared, so others stop seeing the draft until it is reviewed again.
cases.log: Saved: corrected content with editor and edit time; review cleared.

preconditions: No draft exists yet; actor is the current chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting without a draft; actorId: its current chair; edit: three sections.
cases.return: Failure NotDrafted (MSG390 "Chưa có dự thảo để sửa hoặc duyệt."); nothing is saved.

preconditions: A Ready draft exists; actor is the current chair.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting with a Ready draft; actorId: its current chair; edit: sections at exactly 2.000, 12.000 and 8.000 characters.
cases.return: Success (MSG388); sections at the limits are accepted.
cases.log: Saved: corrected content with editor and edit time; review cleared.

preconditions: A Ready draft exists; actor takes part but is neither chair nor secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting with a Ready draft; actorId: an ordinary member; edit: three sections.
cases.return: Failure Forbidden (MSG385 "Chỉ Chủ toạ hoặc Thư ký được tạo, sửa và duyệt dự thảo."); nothing is saved.
